limits: Minimap quantization ~120worldpx/pixel; nearest-dot tracking may switch identities. NPC proximity is candidate association, NOT proven capture. Followup windows overlap. All uses saved pixels/HUD-derived telemetry.

source_checks.controller_map_assumption: body = min(r*.85, sqrt(area/pi)*38) for larger dots; synthetic prey size always capped as edible
source_checks.interpretation: Non-red means not obviously dangerous, not edible. Original controller assigns edible reward to uncertain map points. Dot size rasterization and cap add uncertainty.

next_hypothesis: Do not equate non-red minimap dots with edible prey; retain size uncertainty and require visible reacquisition before assigning edible reward. First calibrate minimap size against visible candidates; do not increase chase persistence blindly.
